name: FFmpeg Tools
author: Viboplr
description: Bulk-convert local tracks to another format, inspect a file's container/stream/tag + loudness info on demand, and give an AI assistant a song's structure (sections, loudness, beats) — all via your system ffmpeg.

permissionReasons.exec:ffmpeg: Convert tracks to other formats, read a file's streams, tags and loudness, and analyse song structure
permissionReasons.library:read: Find the file behind a track you pick to convert, inspect or analyse
permissionReasons.playback:read: Inspect or analyse the playing track when an AI assistant asks without naming a track

binaryDependencies.name: ffmpeg
binaryDependencies.reason: Converts local tracks to another format, probes container/stream/tag + loudness info, and analyses song structure

assistant.instructions: media_info reads a local file's technical facts with ffmpeg: container, duration, bitrate, per-stream codec/sample rate/channels/sample format, embedded tags, and measured loudness (integrated LUFS, true peak, loudness range, a suggested ReplayGain-style gain — informational, nothing is written). Use it to answer questions about a file's format or quality; it decodes the whole file for loudness (about a second for a song) and is not cached. analyze_audio measures a local track's musical structure with ffmpeg: where the music starts and ends, loudness, sections (intro/build/main/peak/breakdown/outro/silence with A/B/C labels for parts that sound alike), loud peaks, a loudness envelope and a beat grid. Call it before writing a clip or a timed cue sheet for a local track; it runs only when you call it (a few seconds for a song, cached afterwards). Times are seconds into the track. Sections, labels, beats and vocals are estimates — each carries a confidence, so treat low values as hints. How to use it: end a title sequence before the intro ends and cut at a section boundary; change images on section boundaries and downbeats, not on a fixed interval; a breakdown is the place for the single biggest visual moment (one or two words), with energy back at the boundary where the rebuild starts; put the closing card on the outro or after musicEndSecs; make beat-synced word hits only when beats.confidence is at least 0.5; sections sharing a label are probably repeats, good for repeated motifs, but don't assume lyrics without timed lyrics. It needs a local file — streams and remote tracks are refused.

tools.name: media_info
tools.description: Technical facts about a local track's file — container format, duration, overall bitrate, audio streams (codec, sample rate, channels, sample format, bitrate), embedded tags, and measured loudness (integratedLufs, truePeakDb, rangeLu, suggestedGainDb). Omit trackId for the playing track.

trackId.description: Library track id. Omit for the currently playing track.

tools.name: analyze_audio
tools.description: Musical structure of a local track — music start/end, integrated loudness, sections with kind/level/label/confidence, loud peaks, a loudness envelope, beats (bpm, beat and downbeat times), and optionally per-band levels and a vocal-presence hint. Omit trackId to analyse the playing track. Times are seconds; heuristic results carry a confidence from 0 to 1.

trackId.description: Library track id. Omit to analyse the currently playing track.

include.description: Which parts to return. Default: sections, envelope, beats. Track, music start/end and loudness are always included.

envelopeHz.description: Envelope points per second (default 1). Capped at about 1200 points, so long files get fewer.
